❌ Unguarded RFC 3329: 420 Plaintext Fallback & SA Exhaustion
1. Spoofed 420 Plaintext Fallback & 494 Bidding-Down Attack
• MITM injects unauthenticated SIP 420 (Unsupported: sec-agree) →
permissive UAC strips sec-agree and dials in plaintext UDP!
• Or MITM edits Step-1 494 Security-Server to ealg=null while server
skips Step-2 Security-Verify === Security-Server byte comparison!
Result: Silent Downgrade of TLS/IPSec Voice Trunk to Plaintext Wiretap
2. Unbounded 494 Challenge Loop & Kernel IPSec SA Exhaustion
• Every 494 Security Agreement Required challenge allocates 2 kernel
XFRM IPSec Security Associations (inbound/outbound SPI + port).
• Uncapped 494 retries under spoofed 200 CPS flood leak 96,000+ half-
open IPSec SAs in 40 seconds, crashing SBC kernel IPsec tables!
Result: SBC Kernel XFRM SA Table Exhaustion & Handshake Deadlock
✅ RFC 3329 Mirror Guard (P903) & 494 Retry/SA Guard (P904)
P903 · RFC 3329 Security-Verify Mirror & [500, 1000] milli-q Guard
• Fail-Closed blocks 100% of 420 (Unsupported: sec-agree) & ealg=null.
• Enforces byte-for-byte Security-Verify === Security-Server check.
• Clamps minimum security mechanism priority to [500, 1000] milli-q.
• 100% defeats MITM bidding-down & plaintext fallback attacks!
clampedDowngradedPlaintextOrUnverifiedSecAgreeSessions = 0 · q ∈ [500, 1000]
P904 · RFC 3329 494 Retry [1, 2]-Cap & Half-Open IPSec SA Reaper
• Clamps 494 Security Agreement Required retries to [1, 2] attempts.
• Aborts looping sec-agree handshakes in 0ms upon exceeding 2 retries.
• Immediately reaps pre-allocated half-open kernel XFRM IPSec SAs
on verification failure or timeout (0 leaked half-open SAs)!
clampedInfinite494RetryOrLeakedHalfOpenIpsecSas = 0 · Retries ∈ [1, 2]
